observations.title: Roster-dependent sidebar
observations.description: A changelog entry documents a hidden/toggle sidebar for one Bot, a narrow rail for two to four, and full sidebar for five or more. These are roster-count rules, not viewport breakpoints.
observations.acceptance: Test counts 1, 2, 4, 5; resizing, manual override and keyboard access.

observations.title: Library preview and pinned sync
observations.description: Library row hover or keyboard focus reveals sender, date and Page visibility; pinned pages, links and files sync across devices per v0.75.2.
observations.acceptance: Test hover/focus parity, touch, pin sync and revoked access.

observations.title: Keyboard attachment reorder
observations.description: The v0.75.2 changelog documents both drag reordering and Alt with arrow keys for composer attachments.
observations.acceptance: Verify announced order, focus, drag parity and cancel.

observations.title: Three-level agent computer access
observations.description: The design article documents active title-bar status, pinned preview and full-screen takeover/handback. The article compares floating, side-by-side, modal and full-screen alternatives.
observations.acceptance: Test preview, manual takeover, return of control, connection failure and visible ownership.

observations.title: Reconnect card and suspended routine
observations.description: The changelog describes reconnect cards and a routine skipping scheduled runs until connector sign-in is restored. It also distinguishes unavailable history from a routine that never ran.
observations.acceptance: Verify sign-out, reconnect, skipped runs, history unavailable and safe resumption; no fake success.

observations.title: Typed chat cards and numeric tables
observations.description: The v0.75.2 changelog documents approval, question, file, link and table cards; approval summaries and sensitive-change flags; source citation chips; file type/name/size and decimal-aligned number columns.
observations.acceptance: Verify semantic labels, focus, safe action review, numeric alignment and narrow viewport.

observations.title: Diagnostic-to-practice learning loop
observations.description: At June 2026 launch, Study Notebooks used uploaded material and a diagnostic quiz to identify gaps, then tailored short lessons with follow-up quizzes.
observations.acceptance: Test diagnostic skip/retry, source grounding, lesson navigation and progress changes; do not claim learning efficacy.

observations.title: Skill-based progress dashboard
observations.description: The announcement describes objectives grouped by topic, Strengths / Focus areas / Not started status labels, automatic updates from quizzes, priority lesson recommendations and filters.
observations.acceptance: Check status change, incomplete quiz, filter reset and reason for priority; no inferred mastery scoring formula.

observations.title: Expandable three-region shell
observations.description: The December 2024 redesign describes expanding the source viewer alongside notes and using chat while audio plays; this is historical documented behavior, not a 2026 pixel audit.
observations.acceptance: Verify current panel widths, collapse, focus, audio continuity and mobile reflow.

observations.title: Mind map node exploration
observations.description: The 2025 announcement documents zooming into sections and selecting concepts to obtain summaries.
observations.acceptance: Test zoom, pan, keyboard node navigation, summary grounding and return focus.

observations.title: Source discovery and import review
observations.description: The April 2025 launch describes a query, a ranked set of up to ten annotated source recommendations, then explicit import. This is a dated historical contract, not a current quota claim.
observations.acceptance: Verify selection, relevance notes, import errors, duplicate and empty results.

observations.title: Explain with source citations
observations.description: The September 2025 announcement connects quiz/flashcard explanations to citations in original learning material.
observations.acceptance: Verify wrong-answer explanation, source anchor, unavailable source and clear distinction from generated reasoning.

observations.title: Textbook catalog as source type
observations.description: The October 2026 announcement documents Add sources → Textbooks for available U.S./India provider titles and inline citations. Do not infer Brazilian catalog availability.
observations.acceptance: Verify catalog eligibility, import, citation, reading rights and unsupported geography.
